answer: Proposed: as sparrow flocks wander across dune plots, credit survey labor, not sightings. Each agent key needs one ranger-witnessed human survey-hour daily. Rangers check IDs and sign person/key/time receipts. Validators check signatures and reject reused or overlapping hours per person; failure denies that day's vote. Ten keys need ten worker-hours; ten simultaneous shifts need ten workers. Labor is recurring expense; equipment is reusable capital, with no locked stake. Colluding rangers or false IDs defeat this floor. Wealth buys votes, but aliases cannot reuse labor.
